value.summary: For the specified exact-decimal binary auxiliary receivers, a nonnegative exact-rational combination of six premise-bound private-message rows gives unit coefficients on both private rates. Expanding the information terms into posterior information functions and applying the common-mean and martingale identities reduces the resulting bound to three scalar posterior groups and an affine prior term.

value.summary: Affine inner majorants and affine outer majorants bound the three reduced posterior groups over the complete interval [0,1]. Exact curvature, ordering, tangent, endpoint, reflection, and directed-interval subdivision arguments establish the inequalities continuously rather than on a sampled grid. The resulting prior bound is concave and reflection symmetric, so its global maximum occurs at the fair prior, yielding the certified narrow interval for U without invoking strong duality, minimax exchange, or receiver optimality.
